evidence_rules.condition: onboarding menuntut effort/investasi signifikan SEBELUM reward pertama dirasakan customer

all_of.text_present_pattern: (sebelum|dulu|baru bisa|belum sempat|belum bisa|belum pernah|sempat|before|previously|only then can|haven't had the chance yet)

evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS that new customers must invest significant effort/steps/training BEFORE feeling the first reward/value.

consequence.rationale: Ability-first + investment-after-reward: friction sebelum nilai = user hilang sebelum sempat terbentuk kebiasaan.

evidence_rules.condition: behavior that is relied on is low-frequency AND its perceived utility is not high (habit zone check fails)
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS onboarding friction so severe that scaling acquisition now would waste the spend (users churn before reaching value).

consequence.rationale: Di luar habit zone: behavior tidak akan otomatis; strategi retensi berbasis habit tidak sah — perlu mekanisme lain (kontrak, ritual kalender, dsb).

evidence_rules.condition: reward penggunaan monoton / dapat diprediksi (finite variability) tanpa elemen baru
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS that usage drops off right after signup/first use (users never log in again after week one).

consequence.rationale: Guaranteed engagement decay (Zynga case): reward variation is the fuel for repeat engagement.

evidence_rules.condition: kurang dari 5% user mencapai frequency benchmark habitual use
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS no habit/repeat usage forming — customers use it once or only when prompted, plus no proof of outcome to show prospects.

consequence.rationale: Product-market-habit belum tercapai: salah segmen atau produk perlu didesain ulang — sebelum di-scale.
